title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du erkennst, warum ein Creative verkauft, hinterfragst Zahlen und weißt, wann eine Kampagne bereit für mehr Budget ist? Dann gestalte mit uns das nächste Wachstumskapitel von Nigela. Das sind wir Nigela ist unsere E-Commerce-Marke rund um Schwarzkümmel. Wir verbinden spezialisierte Produkte mit eigener frischer Ölpressung und einer starken Präsenz auf Social Media. Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir jemanden, der unser Performance-Marketing aktiv vorantreibt: mit starken Creatives, systematischen Tests und einem klaren Blick auf wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern sowie unseren Teams und Partnern aus Influencer-Marketing, Content und Design zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen schnell in die Umsetzung kommen – und messbar etwas bewegen. Aufgaben Meta Ads steuern: Du planst, erstellst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram und verantwortest die operative Budgetsteuerung innerhalb vereinbarter Ziele. Profitabel wachsen: Du bewertest Kampagnen anhand von Neukundenkosten, Umsatz und Profitabilität. Dabei ordnest du Plattformzahlen im Gesamtbild unseres Shops ein. Creatives systematisch testen: Du entwickelst neue Hooks, Botschaften und Werbeansätze, schreibst klare Briefings und leitest aus den Ergebnissen die nächsten Tests ab. Creator-Inhalte skalieren: Gemeinsam mit unserem Influencer-Marketing identifizierst du vielversprechende Inhalte und entwickelst sie zu erfolgreichen Partnership Ads weiter. Die Customer Journey verbessern: Du analysierst den Weg von der Anzeige bis zum Kauf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team passende Angebote und Landingpage-Tests. Zahlen verständlich machen: Du erstellst klare Auswertungen, erkennst Auffälligkeiten im Tracking und übersetzt Daten in konkrete Entscheidungen. Zusammenarbeit voranbringen: Du koordinierst Tests mit internen Teams und externen Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass Erkenntnisse umgesetzt werden. Qualifikation Praktische Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing für E-Commerce- oder D2C-Marken, idealerweise mindestens zwei Jahre. Sicherer Umgang mit dem Meta Ads Manager und Erfahrung mit eigenständig betreuten Kampagnen und Budgets. Ein gutes Gespür für verkaufsstarke Creatives: Du kannst erklären, welche Zielgruppe eine Anzeige anspricht, warum der Einstieg funktioniert und was du als Nächstes testen würdest. Analytisches Denken: Begriffe wie CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate, Warenkorbwert und Deckungsbeitrag sind dir vertraut. Erfahrung mit strukturierten Tests und der Fähigkeit, aus Ergebnissen nachvollziehbare Schlüsse zu ziehen. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du bringst Ideen ein, setzt sie um und kommunizierst klar, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Bewertung und Entwicklung unserer Werbeinhalte. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrung mit Shopify, getKlar, Partnership Ads, UGC, Landingpage-Optimierung oder Google Ads mit. Kenntnisse in mehreren dieser Bereiche sind uns besonders wichtig, da sie deine tägliche Arbeit bei uns prägen werden. Benefits Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und kurze Entscheidungswege. Verantwortung für einen wichtigen Wachstumsbereich unserer Marke. Eine enge Verbindung von Influencer-Marketing, Content und Paid Social. Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und ihre Wirkung direkt zu sehen. Ein physisches Produkt und Einblicke in die Herstellung hinter der Marke. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Based at our global headquarters in <strong>Munich</strong>, as a <strong>Value Engineering Manager / Director</strong> for <strong>CPG &amp; Retail</strong>, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the <strong>CPG &amp; Retail segment across the DACH region</strong>. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.</p> <h2><strong>What Sets Our Patch Apart</strong></h2> <p>The DACH CPG &amp; Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.&nbsp;</p> <p>As our DACH CPG &amp; Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Business Outcomes &amp; Account Growth:</strong> Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG &amp; Retail sector. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform
description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the AI Platform Team at Smartly! Our team works on helping marketers make the most of their ad creatives (images, video, text) and campaigns (product and performance data). We build and experiment with AI-based solutions across the media and creative workflows.You will have the opportunity to take ownership of and work on high impact projects. Join us in building high impact ML-based solutions to help our customers to build better and more effective advertising experiences for their consumers. If you're a growth minded individual who has a passion for ML and the marketing space, this team is for you! We use Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Docker and Kubernetes for our microservices, TypeScript and React in the frontend of our products. Here's What You'll Do... Design, build and maintain backend services that sit at the core of Smartly.io's campaign optimization products. Be a core contributor of our team and our ways of working to build high impact products. You'll actively be involved in work planning, retrospectives, and overall team improvement. Support data scientists in bringing machine learning models to production. Mentor your team on software development practices and propagate best practices like testing, monitoring, or clean code. Use your skills and experience to continuously improve our software architecture, coding practices, tools, and processes. Work with our stakeholders - be them product, engineering, infrastructure - to ensure we meet customers where they are. Being able to translate business/product needs to viable solutions is a must. Apply and enhance your soft skills through working closely with your colleagues and our customers. Doing knowledge shares, running productive meetings, and pair programming/debugging are just some ways we grow our soft skills. Impact the daily life of the staff of the hundreds of advertisers using Smartly Here's What We're Looking For... We're seeking an experienced Software Engineer with Strong Python skills 5+ years of experience developing and deploying production-quality software 2+ years of experience working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP Experience with NodeJS, React, TypeScript is a plus Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) is a plus Knowledge of MLOps concepts and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow) is a plus Experience developing and maintaining services under SLA Analytical mindset with a problem-solving approach Passion for solving customer challenges quickly while making thoughtful architectural decisions Adaptability and resilience when facing new or ambiguous challenges Strong written and verbal communication skills in English Ability to work 3 days / week at our office M.Sc. in a relevant field is preferred What We Offer You... Inclusive Culture: Join a team of over 750 Smartlies representing more than 60 nationalities across 24 locations in 13 countries, we foster a culture built on trust, transparency, and open feedback. Global Impact: Be part of a company making a global impact, directly influencing our customers and business growth. Wellbeing Focus: Enjoy generous healthcare packages, mental health services, and a healthy work-life balance with paid holidays and family leave. Total Rewards: Benefit from equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and ample career development opportunities. Hybrid Workplace: Experience the flexibility of a hybrid work model, balancing office and remote work, with the option to work abroad for up to 30 days. Smartly is committed to being the best place to work for growth-minded individuals to thrive. Explore more in our  Culture Handbook ! #LI-hybrid   About Smartly Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers. You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements.   • Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance.
  • Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration.
  • Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape.
  • Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus.
  • Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems.
  • Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data.
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to design service desks, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services.
  • Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e.g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus.

title: Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: FlixTrain ist die Challenger-Marke im deutschen Fernverkehr: grün, mutig und anders als der Platzhirsch. Auf Social Media wollen wir genau das zeigen, nicht als Kanäle, die „auch noch mitlaufen", sondern als eigenständige Bühne, auf der unsere Marke für digital-first Zielgruppen erlebbar wird.   Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d) , der Organic Social bei FlixTrain weiterdenkt. Einige Kanäle laufen schon, aber ohne eigene Handschrift. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du machst aus mitlaufenden Kanälen eine eigenständige FlixTrain-Präsenz. Du bekommst einen Startpunkt mit Reichweite, aber freie Hand beim Aufbau von Strategie, Struktur, Prozessen und Partner-Setup. Du entscheidest, wo wir spielen und wo nicht, übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformgerecht und machst Wirkung messbar. Die Rolle ist Teil des Brand Teams und bewusst als eigenverantwortliche Aufbaurolle angelegt: Du bist In-House-Kopf und Taktgeber, die Produktion steuerst du über Agentur, Creator und internes Creative Team.   Entscheidend ist eine Haltung: Nähe zum Zeitgeist, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen. Wir wollen Reichweite mit Substanz: Content, der zur Marke passt, nicht bloße Content-Masse.   Über die Rolle   Strategie & Where-to-play   Du entwickelst die  Organic - Social -Strategie für  FlixTrain : klare Ziele, Zielgruppen und Kommunikations-Säulen: abgeleitet aus der übergeordneten Markenstrategie, nicht als Insel.   Du triffst die  Where -to-play-Entscheidung: Du prüfst die bestehenden Kanäle, entscheidest, welche wir fokussieren und welche bewusst nicht, und identifizierst, wo  FlixTrain  zusätzlich präsent sein sollte.   Du definierst das Zusammenspiel aus „Big Moment"-Ideen (große, reichweitenstarke Momente, die kulturelle Relevanz schaffen) und  Ongoing -Community-Content (kontinuierlich, näher an der bestehenden Community)    Markenübersetzung & Content   Du übersetzt die  FlixTrain -Marke plattformnativ – nicht als adaptierten Kampagnen- Cutdown , sondern als eigenständige, kanaltypische Formate, die organisch wirken statt „gebrandet".   Du sorgst dafür, dass Content zum Zeitgeist UND zur Marke passt: Du kombinierst Entertainment- und Kultur-Trends mit echtem Markenfit – kein Trend-Hopping, kein „AI-Slop", kein Content um des Contents willen.   Du betreibst Community Management, hältst die Marke im Dialog präsent und behältst auch bei kritischen Themen einen souveränen Ton – mit dem Gespür, wann ein Fall an PR gehört.   Partner- & Produktions-Setup   Du baust das richtige Partner-Setup auf und steuerst es .  Darüber hinaus managst du das Budget eigenverantwortlich und entscheidest, welche Inhalte gezielt verstärkt werden.   Measurement & Wirkung   Du machst die Wirkung von  Organic   Social  mit den richtigen KPIs je Zielstellung und Maßnahme messbar — von Big-Moment Content bis hin zu  Ongoing -Content — und etablierst ein durchdachtes Reporting, aus dem du gezielt  Learnings  für die nächste Planungsrunde ableitest.   Stakeholder & Schnittstellen   Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team, dem FlixBus  Social  Media Team und dem Creative Team zusammen und sorgst für strategische Konsistenz zwischen  Organic , Paid und Kampagne.   Du bist Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner und vertrittst  Social  souverän gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen.   Über Dich   Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Organic-Social - bzw. Content-Marketing – idealerweise mit Erfahrung auf Unternehmens- und Agenturseite.   Du bist Generalist: Du denkst strategisch ( Where -to-play, KPIs, Positionierung) und bleibst gleichzeitig  hands -on in Redaktionsplanung, Briefing und Steuerung.   Du hast  Social -Strukturen oder -Kanäle aufgebaut oder maßgeblich geprägt, nicht nur verwaltet – du bringst Ownership und Aufbau-Mentalität mit.   Du bist nah am Zeitgeist und kannst Entertainment-/Kultur-Trends lesen – aber mit dem Urteilsvermögen, sie am Markenfit zu messen und auch Nein zu sagen.   Du steuerst Agenturen, Creator und Freelancer sicher und behältst Budget, Timings und Qualität im Blick.   Du nutzt KPIs,  Social  Listening und  Insights  selbstverständlich als Grundlage von Entscheidungen – und erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Reichweite und Wirkung.   Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (jeweils mind.  C1- Niveau).   Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, hier etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.   Was Wir Bieten   Reisevorteile:  12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.   Arbeiten von überall:  Je nach Rolle bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus.   Hybrides Arbeitsmodell:  Bürokultur mit Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.   Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote:  Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Maßnahmen zur Stressbewältigung – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.   Lernen & Entwicklung:  Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.   Mentoring-Programm:  Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.     Warum Teil von Flix werden?   Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten.   Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!  Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer - Perception
raw.description:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Computer Vision Engineer - Perception

Build the perception that lets SE3's autonomous systems see and understand the world, and test your work on real missions.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Perception Engineer, you'll build core parts of SE3's perception stack, from object detection and tracking to semantic segmentation and depth estimation. You'll work closely with our perception leads, founders and autonomy engineers, testing your work on recorded mission data and in field trials. You don't need a career spent in computer vision: we care most about exceptional ability and a strong pull towards the field.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Detection & Tracking: Build and improve object detection and multi-object tracking for our autonomous platforms.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Develop semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a reliable view of the scene.

  • Data & Training: Prepare datasets, train and compare models, and choose approaches based on measured results.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Extend our evaluation and replay tooling so improvements are measured on recorded data before they reach the field.

  • Real-Time Deployment: Optimize models to run on onboard compute under real-time constraints.

  • Field Debugging: Analyze mission logs, reproduce failures and fix root causes until the system holds up in real conditions.

  • Code Quality: Write clean, tested production code and review your teammates' work.

     
 

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of problems from first idea to deployed result, and you learn new areas quickly.

  • You hold an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics or a related field, with an outstanding academic record such as top grades, research assistant roles, awards or competition wins.

  • You bring 2+ years of practical experience at a high-calibre technology company, research lab or startup.

  • You have a strong interest in computer vision, shown through university courses, research, projects or work. If you studied it and want to get back to it, we want to hear from you.

  • You're a strong programmer who writes production-quality code.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.

  • Contributions to open-source computer vision or robotics projects.

  • Experience in a robotics or autonomous racing student team.

  • Deploying models on edge compute such as Jetson-class platforms.

  • Hands-on time with drones or other robots in the field.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min): We work through a practical computer vision or perception software problem together.

  3. Technical Interview (1 hr): We dive into your computer vision background, the systems and projects you have built and how you measure and debug model performance.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

title: Design System Director (x/f/m)
description: <h2><strong>Set a new pulse for healthcare!</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Head of Design Systems</strong> to join the <strong>Brand and Design</strong> team at Doctolib.</p> <p>Your mission will be to ensure every Doctolib product surface is built on a consistent, high-quality design foundation. You will own <strong>Oxygen</strong>, Doctolib's design system - much more than a component library. Oxygen is how we deliver our brand identity consistently throughout the product and the critical infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work will directly shape the experience of more than 90 million patients and 400,000 healthcare professionals.</p> <p>Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <p>Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set the multi-year vision and roadmap</strong> for Oxygen, connecting the dots across engineering, design, and brand teams. Translate system health into business impact and own the investment strategy for the teams, tools, and governance that support it.</li> <li><strong>Establish cross-functional governance</strong> across Design, Product, Engineering, and Brand teams, defining contribution models, change management processes, and the standards other teams are expected to follow.</li> <li><strong>Own design output quality across the product,</strong> ensuring that AI-generated interfaces are coherent, consistent, and on-brand at every touchpoint across the company.</li> <li><strong>Define and drive cross-organizational adoption,</strong> measuring adoption rate, component coverage, and contribution velocity, and connecting those metrics to product team speed and quality.</li> <li><strong>Manage and grow a team of designers, product people and engineers,</strong> setting career paths, a high bar for craft, and hiring for the roles the system needs next.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>You'll be a great fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have <strong>10+ years of experience in product design or design systems,</strong> with a proven track record of scaling a mature, complex system across multiple product teams or lines of business</li> <li>Bring <strong>engineering fluency:</strong> you understand the technical architecture of a design system, how platform teams operate, and the latest best practices in AI-first software engineering as it relates to design systems</li> <li>Have demonstrated <strong>senior stakeholder management skills,</strong> with the ability to negotiate priorities with leadership at Director level and above across large, distributed organizations, and drive change management at scale</li> <li>Take a <strong>data-informed and outcome-oriented approach:</strong> you measure system health in real metrics (adoption rate, handoff defect rate, contribution velocity) and connect those numbers to product quality and business outcomes</li> <li>Have experience in a <strong>regulated, enterprise, or healthcare-adjacent context</strong> where accessibility (WCAG), localization (i18n, RTL), and multi-market constraints are critical to design systems</li> <li>Are <strong>fluent in English</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>It would be fantastic if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience owning large-scale change management programs across cross-functional organizations</li> <li>Speak additional European languages, such as French, German, or Italian</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Life at Doctolib Tech</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.</li> <li>Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.</li> <li>We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision <a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/">here</a>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the</em><a href="https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/"><em> </em><em>Doctolib Tech site</em></a><em>.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Relocation support in case of international mobility</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our interview process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Recruiter Interview</li> <li>Portfolio Review</li> <li>Design System description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members across UK and India</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:</h3> <p>Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.</p> <p>You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring &amp; ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.<br><br>As Director of Engineering, KYX you will</p> <ul> <li>Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.</li> <li>Own KYX Scoring &amp; ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.</li> <li>Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.</li> <li>Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.</li> <li>Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).</li> <li>Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com . The Opportunity We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that. The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you. What You Will Do: Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls. Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review. Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding. What Ramping Up Looks Like: You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end. Why This Role: You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist. You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code. We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day. Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it. Qualifications 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent). 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes. Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus. Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so. Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think. Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives. Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it. Nice to Have: Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript). Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar). Scripting/light coding and API integration experience. Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar. AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure. Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment. Support for you, professionally and personally Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback. A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs. Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more. Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing. We encourage you to apply At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age. For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here . title: Finance Operations Intern (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen – mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen. Deine Rolle In deiner Rolle als Praktikant im Bereich Finance Operations bildest du das verlässliche Rückgrat unseres Finanzteams. Du steuerst die kompletten Abläufe der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, begleitest aktiv die Einführung frischer Systeme sowie Abläufe und agierst als maßgebliche Schnittstelle zu externen Steuerberatern. Gleichzeitig garantierst du reibungslose, strukturierte Prozesse in unseren Tochterunternehmen. An der Seite von Finance Lead und CFO erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in sämtliche Finanzstrukturen, vom einzelnen Beleg bis zur strategischen Liquiditätssteuerung. Was du tun wirst Accounts Payable: Du managst unseren Eingangsrechnungs-Workflow von A bis Z – Postkorb, Invoice Chasing, Freigabeprozesse und Zahlungen ausführen. Sorgfalt und ein Auge für Details sind hier entscheidend. Buchungsqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen mit den richtigen Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätzen erfasst werden. Du bist die erste Instanz, bevor Buchungen zu unseren Steuerberatern gehen, und unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Rückfragen. Tochtergesellschaften: Du überprüfst regelmäßig die BWAs unserer Töchter, erkennst Abweichungen und Unplausibilitäten und stellst sicher, dass vorgegebene Prozesse konsequent eingehalten werden. Liquiditätssteuerung & Systemimplementierung: Du erlernst die Arbeit mit Agicap – unserem zentralen Werkzeug für Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen, Zahlungsabläufe sowie das Liquiditätsmanagement. Zudem begleitest du den Rollout in unseren Tochtergesellschaften, schulst die Teams vor Ort und gewährleistest eine hohe Datenqualität und Vollständigkeit. Ad-hoc & Ops-Schnittstelle: Du packst auch mal an, wenn es brennt. Sei es bei Finance-nahen Sonderprojekten oder gelegentlicher Unterstützung im Ops-Bereich. Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du Ownership liebst und nicht wartest, bis jemand anderes eine Rechnung sucht, einen Fehler korrigiert oder einen Prozess aufräumt – du siehst es, du löst es. Du Buchungen nicht als lästiges Pflichtprogramm siehst, sondern verstehst, warum die Kontenwahl relevant ist – für das Reporting, für die Steuer, für das große Ganze. Du dich in einem Tool schnell zurechtfindest, das du vorher noch nie gesehen hast. Agicap, Moss, Lucanet, Datev – wenn du eines davon kennst, lernst du die anderen schnell. Du in Unklarheit handlungsfähig bleibst. In einem Startup sind Prozesse oft im Aufbau. Du baust mit, anstatt auf fertige Strukturen zu warten. Du Qualität mit Pragmatismus verbindest. Du machst es richtig – aber du weißt auch, wann „gut genug“ besser ist als „perfekt in drei Wochen“. Du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst. Die Kommunikation mit unseren Steuerberatern und Tochtergesellschaften erfolgt auf Deutsch, während wir intern auf Englisch kommunizieren. Hard requirement. Du aus unserem Office in Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten willst. Das ist keine Remote-Rolle. Hard requirement. title: Senior CRM Manager:in (Lifecycle & Retention) I E-Commerce I Growth I Achim, hybrid
description: Kleines Kraftwerk & Du Wir sind Kleines Kraftwerk, ein junges Unternehmen mit großer Ambition. In nur drei Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen und noch lange nicht am Ziel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt. Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen. Du sorgst dafür, dass die richtige Botschaft zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Kund:innen ankommt und machst sichtbar, welchen Beitrag CRM zu unserem Wachstum leistet. Als unser:e neue:r Senior CRM Manager:in / Lifecycle & Retention entwickelst du CRM bei uns von einem bislang nebenbei betriebenen Kanal zu einer echten Wachstumsfunktion. Die Basis ist da: Klaviyo, mehrere hunderttausend Leads und Kund:innen sowie jede Menge Daten. Was fehlt, ist eine klare CRM-Strategie mit intelligenter Segmentierung, automatisierten Lifecycle-Flows, strukturiertem Testing und einem Reporting, das Wirkung und Umsatzbeitrag sichtbar macht. Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen. Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen? Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen. Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus. Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back. Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache. Du verantwortest unsere CRM-Kampagnen: Du steuerst Themen, Timing und Versand und stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und E-Commerce ab. Du etablierst eine Test- und Lernkultur: Mit strukturierten A/B-Tests identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere CRM-Maßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter. Du steuerst die CRM-Performance: Relevante KPIs und Reportings nutzt du, um Erfolge messbar zu machen und konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten. Du stellst Datenqualität und Compliance sicher: Du sorgst für sauberes Listenmanagement und DSGVO-konforme CRM-Prozesse. Du identifizierst die größten CRM-Hebel: Potenziale priorisierst du nach Business Impact und entwickelst perspektivisch weitere Retention-Programme wie Loyalty und Referral. Womit du punkten kannst Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Senior CRM Manager:in /  Lifecycle & Retention

entwickelst du CRM bei uns von einem bislang nebenbei betriebenen Kanal zu einer echten Wachstumsfunktion. Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen.

Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst



CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen. 

  • Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back.
  • Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache.

Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Dabei wartest du nicht auf Vorgaben, sondern erkennst Potenziale und setzt sie eigenständig um.

  • Du kennst CRM aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 4+ Jahre Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld, und hast eine CRM-Funktion bereits aufgebaut oder maßgeblich weiterentwickelt.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und kannst dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und klar verständigen.

  • du ein fertiges CRM-Setup mit bestehenden Prozessen und Playbooks übernehmen möchtest – bei uns baust du vieles selbst auf.
  • du lange Freigabeprozesse einer schnellen, direkten Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung vorziehst.
  • du ausschließlich Kampagnen versenden möchtest, ohne Verantwortung für Segmentierung, Testing und Reporting zu übernehmen.
  • Datenarbeit für dich eher Pflicht als Werkzeug ist und du ausschließlich kreativ arbeiten möchtest.
  • fehlende Prozesse und Unklarheit dich eher stressen als motivieren – ein fertiges CRM-Handbuch gibt es bei uns noch nicht.


Worauf du dich freuen kannst

  • CRM aufbauen statt nur verwalten: Du bekommst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit beim Aufbau unserer CRM-Funktion und kannst Strukturen, Prozesse und Maßnahmen von Grund auf mitgestalten.
  • Eine Datenbasis mit echtem Potenzial: Dich erwartet eine große und stetig wachsende Kontaktbasis – eine seltene Ausgangslage, um mit CRM schnell sichtbare und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

  • Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft liegen uns am Herzen: Du erhältst Zuschüsse zu Wellpass und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie exklusive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte.
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen: Dich erwarten moderne, lichtdurchflutete Büros und eine phänomenale Dachterrasse, die zum Durchatmen und Austauschen einlädt.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien.  Join uns und werde Teil des Teams!

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Start-up im Bereich erneuerbare Energien mit einer klaren Mission: erneuerbare Energie von morgen für alle zugänglich machen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen: in einer dynamischen Umgebung, in der du viel Gestaltungsspielraum hast, Strukturen mit aufbauen kannst, eigene Entscheidungen triffst und direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens nimmst.

title: Product Manager*in (m/w/d)
description: Lust auf Produktgestaltung und Innovation? Willst du Features bauen oder echte Probleme lösen? Wir suchen keinen bloßen „Verwalter von Anforderungen“, sondern einen strategischen Kopf, der unser Produkt zum Marktführer macht. Wir sind ein SaaS-Startup mit einer klaren Mission: Mehrweg in der Logistik so einfach wie Einweg zu machen. Wir reduzieren nicht nur den CO₂-Fußabdruck einer ganzen Branche, sondern optimieren einen ihrer nervigsten Prozesse. Als Product Manager bist du nicht dafür da, Tickets zu schreiben. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass unser Produkt wertvoll für den Kunden und rentabel für unser Business ist. Aufgaben Product Discovery statt bloßer Ausführung: Du bekommst keine fertigen Lösungen vorgesetzt. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, um herauszufinden, was wir bauen müssen. Du validierst Hypothesen schnell und minimierst das Risiko, Dinge zu bauen, die niemand braucht. Outcome über Output: Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an der Anzahl der geschriebenen Tickets oder pünktlichen Releases, sondern an messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen (z.B. Adoption-Rate von Features, Prozess-Effizienz beim Kunden). Tiefes Kundenverständnis: Du wirst zum Experten für unsere Nutzer. Durch kontinuierliche User Interviews und Datenanalysen verstehst du deren Schmerzpunkte besser als sie selbst und leitest daraus die Produktstrategie ab. Business Viability: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen nicht nur nutzbar sind, sondern auch in unser Geschäftsmodell passen und rechtlich sowie technisch realisierbar sind. Qualifikation Liebe zum Problem: Du verstehst den Unterschied zwischen Projekt- und Produktmanagement. Du liebst es, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und übernimmst Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deines Produktbereichs. Evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen: Du verlässt dich nicht auf Bauchgefühl. Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen Discovery-Methoden (Prototyping, A/B-Testing, Customer Interviews) und weißt, wie man Daten nutzt, um Argumente zu stützen. Kollaboration & Kommunikation: Du siehst Entwickler und Designer nicht als "Ressourcen", sondern als Partner. Du kannst Stakeholdern souverän "Nein" sagen, um den Fokus auf das Wesentliche zu wahren, und kannst deine Produktvision begeisternd vermitteln. Hintergrund: Ein Studium ist gut, echte Erfahrung ist besser. Ob Informatik, BWL oder Quereinsteiger: Wichtig ist, dass du Erfahrung im Bauen digitaler Produkte (SaaS) hast und idealerweise schon einmal in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld (Startup) gearbeitet hast. Benefits Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen. Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe,…), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m. Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest. Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst. Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik. Wähle die Incentives, die zu dir passen: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass und das Jobrad. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge 30 Urlaubstage Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.   • Strong knowledge of production and post-production processes from brief through final delivery

title: Senior Sales Director
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.  With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Role Description: Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home. Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale. We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather than in a broad prospecting territory. It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market. Responsibilities: • A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business. • A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion. • The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC, commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay accountable through launch. • The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband P&amp;L. • A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it. • Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late. • A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory. Qualifications: This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for reflects that. • A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many. • Ownership of deals in the multi-million-dollar ACV range, with 9 to 24 month cycles, formal procurement, and an established solution already in place. • Fluency in ISP economics. ARPU and attach rates, churn and retention drivers, cost to serve, contact volumes and handling time, truck roll avoidance, CPE fleet lifecycle and ODM relationships, NPS. You should be able to build a credible business case yourself before a solutions engineer is in the room. • Experience winning business where the customer already had a solution in place, whether bought or built in-house. That is a different commercial conversation, and we place real weight on it. • Existing senior relationships across UK and Ireland ISPs, or a specific and realistic plan for building them inside two quarters. • MEDDPICC applied in practice rather than in theory. Expect to walk us through a live deal from your current role against it. • Comfort operating without a finished playbook. Our product moves, our commercial models evolve, and parts of this territory are still being defined. You will be building as you sell. • Consistent quota attainment, and the ability to explain honestly where you missed and why. • Willingness to travel regularly across UK and Ireland, and occasionally across EMEA. About Plume As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.  Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.   Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. We’re looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own some of our largest and most strategic relationships with UK wealth managers. You’ll be the client’s trusted advisor after the sale, making sure Aveni delivers measurable value across thousands of users, and leading renewals and growth.

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

About the Role

You’ll take full post-sales ownership of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, each worth around £1m. You’ll be the go-to person for your clients, building relationships up to C-suite level, running quarterly business reviews and pulling in Implementation, Support, Product and our leadership team to drive progress.

This is a senior, visible role with a clear path towards Key Account Director or Customer Success leadership.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own customer outcomes: Build and run success plans that show measurable ROI from Aveni.

  • Drive retention and growth: Lead renewals and find expansion opportunities across Aveni Assist and Aveni Detect.

  • Build executive relationships: Become a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders in Operations, Compliance and the C-suite.

  • Orchestrate Aveni: Bring in the right internal teams and leaders at the right time.

  • Run QBRs: Deliver business reviews that tie outcomes to client goals.

  • Drive adoption at scale: Use usage data to find gaps across thousands of users and act on them.

  • Represent the customer: Bring the client voice into product decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • B2B SaaS Experience: Customer success experience in B2B SaaS, managing several large enterprise accounts at once.

  • Agile Environment: Scale-up or start-up experience (or proven success adapting from a large vendor to a smaller business).

  • Commercial Track Record: A proven track record of renewing and expanding accounts while staying customer-centric.

  • Leadership & Presence: Executive presence and confidence with senior stakeholders, combined with a genuine eagerness to learn.

  • Mobility: Comfortable with regular travel to client sites.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with wealth management or wider financial services clients.

  • B2B2C products where success meant adoption across thousands of end users.

  • Experience working with AI or data-driven products.

Benefits

  • Culture & Growth: A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities.

  • Time Off: 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays).

  • Equity: Share options – we believe in shared success.

  • Development: Skills development with continuous learning at our core.

  • Flexibility: Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Life insurance, income protection, private health care, and a 24/7 employee assistance programme for emotional wellbeing.

  • Perks & Pension: Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers, cycle to work scheme, and pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%).

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. As Supplier Coordinator/Analyst, you'll be at the centre of how Product manages its suppliers - making sure Allica stays on top of every review, renewal and requirement across a fast-growing supplier estate, in line with our TPRM framework.

This is an individual contributor role built for someone who thrives on staying ahead of things: you're the person Product comes to for a clear answer on what's due and what's outstanding, and the one who catches a licence, renewal or review before it becomes due.

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.


Why We Need a Platform Security Engineer Now

Omnea takes security seriously. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe.

 

Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification.

 

What We're Looking For

We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff). For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security.

 

Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for.

 

What You'll Do

  • Implement and take ownership of our Security roadmap. Working with the Platform Lead, a successful candidate will steadily take ownership over the Platform Security Roadmap, leading implementations and experiments to level up Omnea’s security posture.

  • Own Security Tooling. From safe-chain plugins to SAST/DAST tooling, we want someone who’s keen to get stuck in, onboard, and evolve our tooling to ensure our posture stays at the bleeding edge.

  • Deliver Compliance Programs. Omnea plans to tackle multiple additional compliance certifications to enable the business to serve some of the most regulated industries on the planet. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards.

  • Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Making sure we can enable that safely and securely will become your wheelhouse.

  • Implement hardening patterns. See an area where code security could be improved? Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff.


What Can You Expect?

  • A strong team. You'll join a platform team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work.

  • Modern, cloud-native stack. Everything serverless and IaC-driven (AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript end-to-end).

  • Continuous delivery. We deploy multiple times a day. Your work determines how fast and safely the whole engineering org ships.

  • Scalability challenges. As we 10x revenue, you'll be a part of evolving our infrastructure to defend against new security threats and keep us one step ahead.

  • Customer impact. Delivering on our compliance goals and successfully handling audits.

  • Massive ownership. You own problems end-to-end, from brainstorming through to production.

  • Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.


About You

  • Platform engineer & builder. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code (TypeScript or similar). You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and security gates at scale.

  • Cloud-native. Deep knowledge of AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, IAM, networking), or equivalent cloud-native experience. You understand serverless and its trade-offs.

  • Security as an enabler. You think about engineers and business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure & security exist to serve the product and the business. You make trade-offs with that in mind.

  • Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything.

  • Culture carrier. You coach teammates, share knowledge freely, and keep calm when things break.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Pulumi or similar IaC frameworks.

  • ISC2 (any level) certification.

  • Experience running SaaS compliance programs (ISO:27001, SOC 2 Type II).

  • Open-source contributions to security, infrastructure, or developer tooling projects.

You can learn more about Engineering at Omnea and our hiring process via our R&D Candidate Hub here.

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!
