Role: AV Technician – Government sector

Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: 40 hours per week, with shifts between 6am and 6pm

Location: Sunbury, UK, but with travel across England & Wales

Salary: £30,000 - £32,000 (dependent on experience), plus company benefits and work vehicle

Interview Process: 2-stage (Virtual and Face-to-face)

 

Kinly is a leading integrator of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, and the largest in Europe, serving as a globally trusted technology advisor to leading organisations. For more than 25 years, we have been designing, developing, integrating and supporting complex audiovisual solutions and businesses rely on us to deliver consistently secure and flexible meeting experiences.

We have a new opportunity for an AV Technician to join our highly collaborative judicial sector team to deliver and install AV requirements into Law Courts around England and Wales on a day-to-day basis.

This role will require extended hours and a willingness to travel and the ideal candidate will need to be smart, well-presented and extremely helpful as the role will be very client facing.

The role will also involve heavy lifting, the movement of large items and the person must be willing to attain Security Clearance if not already held.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Preparing and maintaining Audio Visual equipment

  • Electrical Safety (PAT) testing of all Hire electrical equipment

  • Testing and upkeep of current stock

  • Assisting with maintaining an up-to-date record of all Sunbury based Kinly hire equipment on the internal asset management system

  • Maintaining consumable stock levels for Government hire

  • Securely wiping all Government Hire PCs of sensitive data on return from site and ensuring they are updated with relevant software and security patches

  • Delivery and collection of equipment to client venues, primarily Crown Courts

  • Installing, de-rigging AV requirements to enable presentation of evidence in Law Courts

  • Working with Clients to ensure they receive excellent service

  • Liaising with Clients and the office to ensure smooth running of the events

  • Providing cover for on-site Government Hire installation engineers

 

Skills and experience:

  • Technical knowledge of short-term AV solutions, including: Video set up/control, Audio set up/control & Wired and Wireless signal distribution

  • Basic knowledge of video and audio production and postproduction

  • Logical troubleshooting thought process

  • Knowledge of IT, including Microsoft Office and both Apple and Microsoft operating systems

  • Experience of working in a warehouse environment

  • Good awareness of Health and Safety and safe working practices

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

  • The confidence to work under pressure in a professional environment

  • A UK driving license

  • Flexibility as overtime will be involved, including some weekends, evenings and overnight stays required

  • Comfortable going through the Security Clearance vetting (organised by Kinly).

 

If you are selected for interview, and need any reasonable adjustments made for your interview, please let the Talent Acquisition team know, at the point of scheduling.

 

If you do require details of the vacancy or the application process in an alternative format, please email 

 

Equal Opportunities:

Kinly is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, gender identity, pregnancy, colour, race, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, religion or any other ‘protected characteristics. We welcome your application.

raw.title: Data Engineer - Senior Consultant
raw.description:
Ready to build data platforms, not just pipelines?

 

At Opencast, we believe great data engineering is about more than moving and transforming data. It's about creating reliable, scalable foundations that help organisations make better decisions and deliver better services. 

 

Our consultants tackle complex engineering challenges across integration, migration, modelling and platform design, working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure and modern data technologies. We value engineering craft, thoughtful problem-solving and building solutions that are simple, robust and built to last. 

 

As our data engineering capability continues to grow, you'll have the opportunity to influence its direction through delivery, mentoring, recruitment and technical leadership. If you're looking for a role where you can shape both solutions and the capability around them, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

The role

  

Opencast data engineers help organisations transform how they manage, use and learn from data. The work ranges from building modern lakehouse and warehouse platforms in Microsoft Fabric to modernising legacy environments, migrating complex workloads and improving the quality, governance and reliability of critical data services.  

 

This role offers the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, combining platform design, engineering, integration and optimisation. Expect to work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, building batch and near real-time data pipelines that underpin critical business and public services.  

 

You'll collaborate with architects, analysts, software engineers and client teams to solve complex challenges and influence technical direction. The role also offers opportunities to contribute beyond delivery through mentoring, recruitment, community building and helping to define engineering standards and best practice as our capability continues to grow. 

 
 

Requirements

 
This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.
 
Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 
 
SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.
 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.
 

We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 

 
 

Essential experience

 
 
We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems and care about building solutions that are robust, scalable and built to last. 
 
Experience in the following areas is important: 
  • Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouse, warehouse, notebooks and pipeline capabilities.  
  • Building enterprise-scale data platforms, lakehouses and data warehouses.  
  • Data modelling and dimensional modelling techniques such as Kimball. 
  • ETL/ELT development and large-scale data integration.  
  • PySpark, Spark SQL and modern transformation techniques.  
  • Advanced SQL and relational databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Oracle. 
  • Integrating structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources.  
  • Migration and modernisation of legacy platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server/SSIS or Synapse.  
  • Power BI semantic models, curated datasets and supporting analytics platforms. 
  • Data quality, governance, metadata management and lineage. 
  • Data security, classification and access control approaches. 
  • Automated testing, validation, reconciliation testing and performance optimisation. 
  • DataOps, CI/CD and version control practices.  
  • Agile delivery environments. 
 

Essential consulting skills

 
 

Our clients look to us for more than technical delivery. 

 

Success in this role comes from being able to navigate ambiguity, solve difficult problems and help clients make confident technical decisions. The strongest consultants combine technical expertise with curiosity, pragmatism and a collaborative mindset. 

 

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy: 

  • Solving complex engineering challenges and exploring different approaches to finding the right solution.  

  • Influencing technical direction through expertise, evidence and constructive challenge.  

  • Working closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand underlying problems rather than simply implement requirements.  

  • Balancing engineering quality, governance, security and reliability with business outcomes.  

  • Sharing knowledge, mentoring others and helping raise engineering standards.  

  • Building trusted relationships with clients and acting as a technical advisor.  

  • Keeping pace with emerging technologies and evaluating new approaches where they can add value.  

  • Contributing to a growing engineering capability while remaining close to delivery and technology. 

 

 

Salary

 
£61,000 - £70,000 per annum.
 

What we offer


A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work


This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you


We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview


Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.
 

Want to know more?  


Visit our website or email

description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward. &nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.&nbsp;</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Shape the future of our Android team</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Review pull requests, and support other teammates</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges&nbsp;</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">5+ years of software engineering experience</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Familiarity with Android components</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Product design intuition and user empathy</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Excellent communication skills</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">User oriented problem solving approach</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Driven with continuous feedback from leaders</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>Bonus:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>Technologies we use:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Kotlin</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Kotlin Coroutines</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Kotlin Flow</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Jetpack Navigation</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Dagger 2</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Room</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Custom Views, Canvas &amp; Paint</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Jetpack Compose</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">JUnit</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We offer</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.</li> <li>A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.</li> <li>An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.</li> <li>Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.</li> <li>Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.</li> <li>Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.</li> <li>Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> title: Senior MLOps Engineer - Edge
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer for our Hardware Group to build and scale the machine learning infrastructure that powers Focus, our line of smart cameras. You'll own the edge deployment pipelines that transport neural networks from training clusters to tens of thousands of devices globally, and contribute to the platform that compiles trained models into optimised inference engines for devices like the Jetson Orin, building the "nervous system" for the next generation of automated sports capture.</p> <p>As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build scalable Edge infrastructure.</strong> You'll design, develop, and maintain the delivery systems that enable us to deploy models to fleets of devices.</li> <li><strong>Own the model compilation platform.</strong> You'll build and maintain the pipeline that takes trained models and produces optimised, hardware-specific inference engines — managing TensorRT compilation, precision trade-offs (FP16/INT8), calibration, and engine validation to ensure models run reliably and efficiently on target devices.</li> <li><strong>Work with cross-functional teams.</strong> You'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Embedded Engineers, and Product Managers to ensure smooth integration of complex features and capabilities</li> <li><strong>Drive automation and reliability.</strong> You'll implement infrastructure to silently test candidate models on production devices and build telemetry pipelines to monitor drift, thermal impact, and inference latency in the wild.</li> <li><strong>Solve complex physical challenges.</strong> You'll tackle the unique constraints of the edge - building resilient update mechanisms for low-bandwidth environments, optimising for limited storage, and ensuring devices recover gracefully from network failures.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and lead.</strong> You'll share your expertise to establish best practices in Python tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD, guiding the team toward a more robust, automated future.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our offices in London or Barcelona, but we're also open to remote candidates in the UK and Spain.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Production MLOps expertise. </strong>You've played a key role in building and operating pipelines that deploy models to production, with deep experience in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and Linux systems.</li> <li><strong>Edge inference &amp; compilation know-how. </strong>You have hands-on experience compiling and optimising models for embedded hardware - ideally with TensorRT - and understand the practical implications of precision, quantisation, and engine validation at scale.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative.</strong> You understand that shipping to hardware is a team sport and can communicate effectively with researchers and low-level embedded engineers to translate constraints into solutions.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinking.</strong> You can design architectures that handle failure gracefully and understand the implications of deploying to 10,000 heterogeneous devices, including how to manage risk via canary releases and safe rollbacks.</li> <li><strong>Bias towards action.</strong> You see your role as solving problems; this means filling gaps and taking initiative as needed to help the team win together.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience with our Edge AI stack.</strong> Experience with the NVIDIA edge ecosystem (Jetson Orin, DeepStream SDK, TensorRT) is a huge plus.</li> <li><strong>Video Technologies.</strong> Familiarity with video pipelines, GStreamer, or ffmpeg.</li> <li><strong>Fleet management.</strong> Experience with tools like AWS IoT Greengrass, Balena, or custom OTA / fleet management solutions.</li> <li><strong>Sports Passion.</strong> You have an interest in sports technology, video analytics, or performance metrics—but if not, we'll teach you the domain.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. rotating&nbsp;days and nights, 0600-1800 and 1800-0600.</p> <p><strong>Let's Discuss What's On The Table For You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes<br>● Company pension title: Engineering Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h2>About Axon</h2> <p>Axon’s mission is bold and simple: Protect Life. We build technology that gives first responders, enterprises and communities the clarity to act in the moments that matter most.</p> <p>Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, powered by Fusus, is transforming how public safety and security organisations detect, assess and respond to incidents. By connecting live video, devices and operational systems, we help customers build a shared understanding of what is happening—and respond with greater confidence.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Director of Software Engineering to help build and scale the mission-critical software behind these experiences.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>As Director of Software Engineering within Real-Time Operations, you will lead multiple engineering teams delivering secure, reliable and scalable software for public safety and enterprise customers.</p> <p>You will own the technical direction and engineering execution for your area, translating product priorities into clear plans and measurable outcomes. Working closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders, you will guide architectural decisions, develop engineering talent and ensure teams deliver software that customers can depend on.</p> <p>This role requires a leader who combines technical depth with strong people leadership. You will be comfortable moving between long-term strategy and delivery detail—challenging assumptions, making trade-offs and creating the conditions for teams to do their best work.</p> <h2>Your Impact</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver technology that matters.</strong> Lead teams building software that supports real-time situational awareness and incident response.</li> <li><strong>Shape technical direction.</strong> Establish a clear technical strategy that balances customer needs, platform reuse and long-term maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Build strong teams.</strong> Develop engineering managers and technical leaders, strengthening ownership, collaboration and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Raise engineering standards.</strong> Improve reliability, security and delivery quality across systems that span devices, cloud services and user-facing applications.</li> <li><strong>Connect strategy to execution.</strong> Partner with Product and Design to turn customer problems into prioritised roadmaps and dependable delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>VP, Software Engineering</p> <p><strong>Work Location:</strong> This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.</p> <p><strong>Role &amp; Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop multiple software engineering teams, setting clear expectations for technical quality, delivery and team performance.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Design to define roadmaps, sequence investments and make informed trade-offs between new capabilities, platform improvements and technical debt.</li> <li>Guide architecture and system-design decisions across your area, engaging directly with engineers on complex technical challenges.</li> <li>Build engineering practices that strengthen testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and deployment confidence.</li> <li>Own the operational health of your services, using incidents and customer feedback to drive lasting improvements.</li> <li>Hire, coach and develop engineering managers, technical leads and engineers; address performance issues with clarity and candour.</li> <li>Collaborate across Axon to deliver integrated experiences and resolve dependencies between teams.</li> <li>Work with Security, Privacy and Compliance partners to embed customer and regulatory requirements into engineering decisions.</li> <li>Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly, creating alignment without adding unnecessary processes.</li> </ul> <h2>What You Bring</h2> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of total experience in software engineering, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles, with experience leading teams and developing engineering leaders.</li> <li>A track record of delivering complex software products through multiple teams, from planning and architecture through launch and operation.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency in distributed systems, cloud services and modern software architecture.</li> <li>Experience building secure, reliable systems where availability, performance and customer trust are critical.</li> <li>Proven ability to balance delivery commitments with the investment needed to improve platform quality and maintainability.</li> <li>Strong judgement in ambiguous environments, with the ability to make decisions, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product, Design and other engineering organisations.</li> <li>A commitment to building inclusive, high-trust teams and developing talent.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Real-time systems, video streaming, IoT or device-to-cloud architectures.</li> <li>Enterprise security, public safety technology or other mission-critical software environments.</li> <li>Platform modernisation, complex integrations or scaling products across international markets.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Mission-driven:</strong> You connect engineering decisions to meaningful outcomes for customers and communities.</li> <li><strong>Customer-obsessed:</strong> You work backwards from customer needs and stay close to how your software is used.</li> <li><strong>Technically credible:</strong> You ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions and help teams make sound architectural decisions.</li> <li><strong>A multiplier:</strong> You develop other leaders and create an environment where teams can take ownership and succeed.</li> <li><strong>Candid and collaborative:</strong> You give clear feedback, welcome different perspectives and join forces across organisational boundaries.</li> <li><strong>Accountable for outcomes:</strong> You bring focus to complex priorities and follow through on commitments.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits that Benefit You</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Competitive base salary and RSUs.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Private health insurance &amp; cash plans</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">GymPass subscription</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Life assurance &amp; income protection</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Career growth support and wellness resources</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- via our&nbsp;<a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Axon Privacy Web Form</a>. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.</a></em></p> <p><em>Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.</em></p> <p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a ---------- </a>&nbsp;Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.</em></p> <p>Phishing alert:&nbsp; Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.&nbsp; All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at <a href="https://www.axon.com/careers">https://www.axon.com/careers</a>. &nbsp;If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not ----- or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Founded in 2020, unybrands is the next-generation brand accelerator platform built to acquire, integrate, and scale digital-first consumer brands. Headquartered in Miami, with offices in New York, London, Berlin, and Shenzhen, our 240+ team brings deep expertise across e-commerce, brand management, consumer retail, operational scaling, and M&amp;A.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Since inception, we have acquired 30+ brands across Pet Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Supplements, Baby &amp; Juvenile, Garden &amp; Outdoor, Sports &amp; Fitness, and Home &amp; Lifestyle — completing 20+ acquisitions and delivering 16 consecutive quarters of like-for-like organic growth post-integration.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Our competitive advantage lies in a fully integrated operating system purpose-built to transform digital brands into omni-channel category leaders. Powered by a proprietary technology stack built on NetSuite ERP with 200+ data integrations, our platform enables brands to thrive across marketplaces, direct-to-consumer channels, and brick-and-mortar retail.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">We focus on acquiring digital-first brands within carefully selected verticals, then applying tailored value creation playbooks that drive growth through innovation, expansion, and automation. We believe the next generation of consumer brands will be built differently — and we're building the AI-enabled retail tech platform to help them consolidate and win.</p></div><p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing the entire supply chain process, from supplier coordination and logistics to warehouse operations and Amazon FBA management.&nbsp;</p> <p>This leadership role is responsible for ensuring product availability, reducing operational risks, and driving operational excellence across the category. This individual will lead, develop, and mentor a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a high-performing and collaborative culture while delivering consistent business results through optimization).</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Inventory &amp; PO Management</span></p> <ul> <li>Lead weekly PO planning, balancing demand, inventory, and working capital.</li> safeguarding service levels.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Logistics &amp; Fulfillment</span></p> <ul> <li>Manage inbound and outbound flows in coordination with 3PLs and supporting teams.</li> <li>Ensure timely, cost-effective movement of goods to warehouses, FBA, and other nodes.</li> <li>Resolve logistics issues quickly and escalate risks with solutions.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement to reduce lead times and end-to-end costs.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Reporting &amp; Analytics</span></p> <ul> <li>Deliver weekly updates category supply chain performance.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Stakeholder Management</span></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the orchestrator between commercial and supply chain We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to lead and evolve our performance marketing function across regions.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced performance marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing deep expertise in paid acquisition and a strong understanding of full-funnel growth in a B2B SaaS environment.

You will act as the central connector between brand, regional marketing, partnerships, and our external performance agency, ensuring performance marketing not only drives demand, but also improves conversion and contributes directly to pipeline and revenue.

You will be responsible for ensuring performance marketing effectively connects local brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU) through to conversion and revenue (MOFU/BOFU), adapting strategies to reflect market-specific dynamics, verticals, and customer behaviour across geographies.

 
 

How you’ll make an impact

Success in this role will come from building a scalable, insight-driven performance engine that drives measurable business growth across markets, within our ICP and target segments:

  • Driving pipeline and revenue growth through performance marketing across regions

  • Connecting brand, demand creation, and conversion into a cohesive full-funnel strategy

  • Ensuring performance marketing supports inbound, outbound and partner-led growth

  • Delivering locally relevant performance strategies that reflect market maturity and vertical focus

  • Improving conversion rates and efficiency across the funnel

  • Providing clear visibility into what is driving demand, conversion, and revenue across geographies

  • Strengthening collaboration between performance, brand, regional teams, and sales

 

What you’ll do

Performance Strategy & Planning

  • Define and execute a holistic performance marketing strategy aligned to business, regional and vertical priorities

  • Translate pipeline and revenue targets into channel strategies, budget allocation, and investment plans

  • Ensure a full-funnel approach across all geographies, connecting:

    • Brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU)

    • Consideration and engagement (MOFU)

    • Conversion and revenue generation (BOFU)

  • Identify and prioritise new growth opportunities across channels, audiences, and markets

 

Channel Performance & Optimisation

  • Own performance across all paid acquisition channels (e.g. search, social, display, affiliates)

  • Drive continuous testing and experimentation across targeting, creative, landing pages, and funnel

  • Optimise for end-to-end performance (traffic → lead → opportunity → revenue), not just lead volume

  • Ensure budget is allocated effectively based on performance, incrementality, and scalability

  • Adapt channel strategies to reflect local market context, verticals, and customer behaviour

 

Demand, Conversion & Insights

  • Own performance reporting and insights across:

    • Pipeline and revenue contribution

    • Conversion rates across funnel stages

    • Cost efficiency (CPL, CAC, LTV:CAC)

  • Provide clear, actionable insights to:

    • Regional marketing teams (what’s driving local demand)

    • Brand team (what messaging and creative is converting)

    • Sales and leadership (pipeline quality and opportunities)

  • Surface early signals on opportunities and risks across markets

  • Ensure clear visibility of how TOFU activity translates into MOFU/BOFU outcomes across geographies

 

Agency & Stakeholder Management

  • Own and lead the relationship with our global performance marketing agency, ensuring:

    • High-quality execution and optimisation

    • Strategic input and proactive recommendations

    • Clear accountability against KPIs

  • Ensure agency output reflects local market needs, not just global scale

  • Act as the key liaison between brand, regional teams, partnerships, RevOps and external partners

  • Align stakeholders on performance, priorities, and growth opportunities

 

Technology & Tracking

  • Ensure all paid channels are accurately tracked, measured, and integrated across systems (e.g. Salesforce, marketing automation)

  • Partner with RevOps and Data teams to improve attribution, tracking, and reporting infrastructure

  • Ensure full-funnel visibility across geographies, connecting campaign performance to revenue outcomes

  • Set clear priorities, goals, and development plans

  • Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement

You’ll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations, partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, commercial teams, and customers. This is a highly technical product role focused on building storage services that are high-performance, reliable, scalable, and easy to consume. Define product requirements across object, block, and file storage, as well as the integration with the existing Radiant services. Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, APIs, workflows, service levels, and priorities. Partner with engineering on storage architecture, performance, durability, availability, networking, and platform integration. Work with customers and internal teams to understand workload requirements around capacity, throughput, latency, resilience, and cost. Drive integrations with compute, Kubernetes, IAM, observability, and developer tooling. Own prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous iteration. Define success metrics across performance, reliability, utilisation, adoption, and unit economics. Qualifications: Experience owning technical products, cloud infrastructure, storage platforms, or developer-facing infrastructure services. Strong understanding of high performance storage systems (WEKA, VAST, DDN) and cloud storage workloads. Strong technical fluency across: Storage: object, block, file, snapshots, replication, caching Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, APIs Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, networking, cloud platforms Reliability: durability, availability, consistency, failure recovery Observability & security: metrics, logging, IAM, encryption, auditability Familiarity with technologies such as Weka, Vast, DDN, MinIO, Lustre, Pure Storage, or similar. Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity. Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working closely with engineers and customers on highly technical problems. Product thinking: Turn complex infrastructure into simple, consumable services. Technical fluency: Work credibly across storage, networking, compute, APIs, and distributed systems. raw.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
raw.description:
Talent Acquisition Manager

Location: Hybrid remote/Aldgate, London. 1-3 days per week onsite

Salary: £75,000-£90,000

SC Clearance Requirements:

Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for this position. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance.

You must be UK-based.

At a glance

This isn’t a desk to run from the sidelines. You’ll build a team of five, and you’ll carry a quota alongside them, because the fastest way to earn a recruiter’s trust is to be in the market doing the job yourself.

The moment

Cloudscaler is 130 people today, heading to 170 by the end of this year and roughly double again across 2027. Every one of those hires has to come through a Talent Acquisition function that is being rebuilt, not simply inherited.

You’re backfilling a role, but not into the same role. We’re changing the shape of it: less oversight from a distance, more hands directly in the market, and a team built around you from close to a standing start.

We’ve leaned on agencies to cover gaps in the past, and it hasn’t delivered what it should have. That’s part of why this role exists: to build an internal team good enough that we need agencies far less.

What makes this different

Most Talent Acquisition Manager roles are one step removed from the desk. You review pipeline in a dashboard, chase recruiters for updates and step in only when something stalls. That’s not this.

  • Rather than managing a desk from a distance, you’ll carry your own requisitions alongside the team.

  • Rather than reviewing pipeline after the fact, you’ll build the direct-sourcing pipeline yourself, in the toughest markets.

  • Rather than outsourcing hard roles to agencies, you’ll own the reduction in agency spend, personally.

  • Rather than inheriting a settled team, you’ll build a team of five from close to zero.

To be clear about the level: this is a player-manager role, not a strategic seat one step back from delivery. You’ll fill roles yourself while you build and coach the team around you. That combination is the job, not a phase you grow out of.

The role

You’ll lead Talent Acquisition, reporting to the Chief People Officer, with three to five Talent Acquisition Partners reporting to you from day one. You’ll personally own the senior, technical and business-critical hires, while building your team’s capability, capacity and direct-sourcing discipline underneath you.

Two things define the job. The first is delivery: you carry your own quota and remain close enough to the market that you can spot a stalled pipeline or a shifting candidate expectation before it becomes a missed hire. The second is building: assembling a team from close to scratch, giving each Partner a vertical to own, and instilling a direct-sourcing-first culture rather than a dependency on agencies and job boards.

Where the role starts and stops

New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today.

Yours: Full-cycle recruitment delivery and team leadership. Personally leading senior, technical and business-critical hires. Building and coaching Talent Acquisition Partners. Ashby ownership and data quality. Direct-sourcing strategy and capability. Agency relationships, spend and the plan to reduce reliance on them. Cost-per-hire and pipeline reporting.

Shared: The handover from offer to start date, which the People Partner team picks up for onboarding and clearance. Early careers programmes, which a Talent Acquisition Partner will own day to day with your oversight. Broader People systems architecture, which sits with the CPO.

Not yours: Employee relations casework, onboarding delivery and clearance coordination, which sit with the People Partner team. The design of the wider People strategy and operating model, which sits with the CPO.

The stack

You won’t be handed a settled toolkit and told to leave it alone. Part of the job is making these systems earn their keep.

  • Ashby: Our applicant tracking system, and yours to own. Workflows, pipeline stages, reporting and data quality all sit with you, for your whole team.

  • Metaview: Interview intelligence, feeding into how you quality-assure interviews and coach the team’s technique.

  • Rippling: The single source of truth for the employee record. You’ll work in it from offer through to handover and lean on its reporting for headcount and cost-per-hire data.

  • Claude: Cloudscaler is an Anthropic partner. You’ll use it daily for role briefs, market mapping, candidate communication and case preparation.

What you’ll do

Carry your own quota. You’ll personally lead recruitment for our most senior, technical and business-critical roles, staying close enough to the market to spot problems before they cost a hire.

Build the team. You’ll grow Talent Acquisition to three to five Partners, giving each one a technical vertical to own and coaching them from requisition to offer.

Make direct sourcing the default. You’ll lead our Sourcing First approach in practice, not on a slide, building your own pipelines and teaching your team to do the same.

Reduce agency reliance. You’ll manage the agency relationships that remain, hold them to account, and shrink the spend as your internal pipeline strengthens.

Own the numbers. Cost per hire, time to fill, pipeline health and Ashby data quality are yours to report on, and yours to improve.

Back early careers. You’ll give a Talent Acquisition Partner room to build our graduate and apprentice pipeline, with your steer on shape and priority.

Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude and Metaview to take routine work off your desk and your team’s, so more of the week goes on the market and the people in it.

What success looks like at 12 months

  • Your team is at full strength (three to five Partners), and each owns a vertical with a live direct-sourcing pipeline.

  • Cost-per-hire, time-to-hire and quality-of-hire have moved in the right direction, and agency spend is materially down.

  • Senior and business-critical roles are closing without stalling in interview or offer.

  • Ashby data is clean enough that pipeline reporting can be trusted without checking it first.

  • An early careers cohort has been hired and started, owned day-to-day by one of your Partners.

  • Hiring leaders come to you with a problem, not a job description, because they trust the process.

Who we’re looking for

A full-cycle recruiter at heart. You’ve carried a quota and closed hard roles yourself, and you’re not looking to leave that behind for a purely oversight role.

A genuine direct sourcer. You build pipelines rather than waiting for applications, and you can teach that skill to others.

A first-time or early people manager, or ready to be one. You want to build and coach a small team, not just manage a desk.

Credible in technical markets. You can hold a real conversation with engineering and cloud hiring leaders about what good looks like.

Data-literate. You’re comfortable owning cost-per-hire and pipeline reporting yourself, not waiting for someone else to produce it.

Comfortable rebuilding, not just running. This team is being reshaped, not inherited whole. You’ll enjoy the first six months more than most people would.

The honest part

You’re inheriting a function that needs rebuilding, including some agency relationships that haven’t delivered and a team that doesn’t exist yet at full strength. That means real early weeks spent both recruiting for your own roles and recruiting your own team.

You are not stepping into a settled operation with a mature bench around you. What you get instead is the chance to build the team and the sourcing culture from the ground up, with a mandate to change how recruitment gets done here.

This probably isn’t for you if you want to manage from a dashboard, or if carrying your own requisitions feels like a step backwards. It probably is for you if you want to prove a leaner, sourcing-led team can outperform an agency-dependent one, and build it yourself.

If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk.

Benefits

  • Periodic offer of share options schemes

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • 25 days’ annual leave + 5 additional days for training/exams or volunteering

  • Travel and accommodation expensed where eligible in line with our expenses policy

  • Life Assurance

  • Long Term Disability cover

  • Employee Assist Programme for employee advice and support (including legal and counselling helpline)

  • Health, Mental Health, Wellbeing, Financial and Legal support

  • 24/7 GP access

  • Public holiday opt-out scheme giving you the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you

  • Individual training and development plans with online training and exam costs covered

  • Recruitment referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to someone we then hire

  • Customer referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to a new customer

  • Cycle To Work Scheme

  • Dog friendly office

raw.title: Senior Growth Manager
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

As our Senior Growth Manager (Performance Marketing) for the US and Mexico, you'll be the operational engine behind our growth in two new markets. Reporting to the Head of Growth, you'll own the tactical campaign management of our digital acquisition across the US and MX - standing up channels from scratch, finding what works, and scaling the winners. You'll manage significant budgets on Meta, TikTok and Google Ads, identify and iterate on winning creative concepts, and optimise conversion funnels for two very different markets.

You'll be part of a lean, high-performing team of operators. At Lendable, individual contributors wear many hats. We ask ourselves: what's the most impactful thing I can achieve this week? And then own that thing end to end. This role combines digital strategy with hands-on performance marketing execution - perfect for someone who's a deep specialist in one or more digital channels, with the breadth and appetite to learn fast and build in unfamiliar territory.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities others miss, and gets genuinely excited about turning creative concepts into scaled winners - in markets where there's no existing playbook to lean on. You'll work with sophisticated attribution models, systematic creative testing frameworks and modern growth methodologies.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • 2–4 years in performance marketing with a strong creative tilt, preferably D2C, challenger brands and/or fintech

  • Deep hands-on Meta, Google Ads and TikTok campaign management experience, managing multi-million annual budgets

  • A strong understanding of effective hooks, messaging and creative formats for social media

  • Familiarity with attribution modelling and incrementality testing concepts

  • A strong analytical mindset; SQL proficiency preferred

  • Comfortable creating and working with AI tools to enhance productivity and analysis

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building in new audiences and markets without an established playbook

Desirable:

  • Experience launching or scaling acquisition in the US and/or Mexican markets

  • Spanish language skills valued but not essential

  • Experience standing up a digital channel or market from scratch

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated consumer categories

You're a good fit if you're:

  • An owner: you see digital marketing opportunities and execute them without detailed instructions

  • Creative and analytical: you balance intuition with data-driven decision making

  • Detail-oriented: you catch performance patterns others miss and build robust testing processes

  • Energised by greenfield: you'd rather build the engine in a new market than take the reigns from someone else

  • Growth-minded: you're here to learn, improve and take on bigger challenges

What you'll be doing

Channel Strategy & Scaling:

  • Own the D2C acquisition strategy for the US and Mexico across paid social and search, driving volume and efficiency against ambitious incremental CAC targets

  • Lead the launch and scale of new high-potential channels while ensuring Meta, Google and TikTok maintain a best-in-class foundation from day one

  • Establish what works in two distinct markets and build the repeatable playbook to scale it

Creative Engine:

  • Drive the performant creative engine: translate customer insights and winning patterns to inform clear, data-informed briefs for our external creator network, ensuring high-performing video content is produced at speed

  • Systematically analyse creative output to build and refine our hook and concept library, providing actionable feedback to the in-house creators

  • Adapt messaging and creative to the cultural and linguistic nuances of the US and Mexican audiences

Optimisation & Measurement:

  • Execute daily and weekly optimisations across paid channels, leveraging internal attribution models to inform bidding and budget allocation decisions

  • Maintain and audit the conversion tracking setup to ensure accurate, high-quality signal engineering for ad platform algorithms

  • Actively triangulate results from multiple attribution sources (e.g. MMM, internal models, incrementality tests) to drive as much impact as possible

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 🎯  Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous En tant qu ’ Expert.e métier DataSpaceLab, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en développement, recherche et innovation rattaché à la Direction du Développement et des relations avec les Entreprises (DVE). Vous y conjuguez développement de partenariats, innovation et impact sociétal au service des grands enjeux industriels et de santé. Le Data Space Lab est la brique opérationnelle du Hub France de Gaia-X, l’initiative européenne de référence pour les espaces de données et la souveraineté numérique, porté par l’Institut Mines-Télécom. title: Chargée ou chargé d'affaires réglementaires - CDD 12 Mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) ! Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé. 🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions. 💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous Au sein du Centre Ingénierie et Santé et du MedTechLab, vous contribuez au déploiement d’une stratégie technico-réglementaire permettant de sécuriser le développement, l’expérimentation, l’évaluation et, le cas échéant, la mise sur le marché de produits et services innovants en santé, notamment de dispositifs médicaux et de solutions de santé numérique. Le MedTechLab®, cofondé par Mines Saint-Étienne, AÉSIO Santé et AÉSIO Mutuelle, est un espace d’open innovation dédié à la co-création, la modélisation, le test et l’expérimentation d’innovations pour la santé et l’autonomie. Lauréat de l’appel à projets Tiers Lieux d’Expérimentation de France 2030, il accompagne industriels, start-up et acteurs sanitaires et médico-sociaux dans des études d’usage, études cliniques, analyses médico-économiques, études de marché et démarches allant jusqu’au développement de produits minimum viables. Vous intervenez en appui des équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, en lien avec les partenaires académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Vous accompagnez les projets sur leurs différentes étapes : R&D, stratégie réglementaire, recherche clinique, gestion des risques, constitution et maintenance de la documentation technique, marquage CE et suivi post-marquage. Objectif du poste : garantir la prise en compte des exigences réglementaires et qualité applicables aux projets du MedTechLab et développer une culture partagée des affaires réglementaires au sein de l’écosystème. Vos missions principales : • Contrôler la conformité des activités et des processus au regard des référentiels applicables et contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de la documentation des systèmes et outils qualité. • Dans le cadre du projet PREMYOM, accompagner le comité d’éthique interne du consortium en lien avec les DPO des différents partenaires. • Identifier les normes et réglementations applicables aux projets de recherche et d’innovation du MedTechLab, assurer une veille réglementaire et normative et coordonner cette veille avec les partenaires. • Accompagner la mise en œuvre des normes ISO 14155, ISO 13485 et ISO 14971, notamment pour les études cliniques, les systèmes de management de la qualité et l’analyse des risques. • Accompagner les équipes dans la conformité des recherches cliniques et apporter un appui méthodologique et technique. • Contribuer aux stratégies de marquage CE : supervision et rédaction des dossiers techniques, déclarations de mise sur le marché, maintien de la documentation de conformité et suivi post-marquage. • Piloter l’évaluation réglementaire des changements, gérer la liste des normes appliquées aux projets et traiter les questions réglementaires et techniques des autorités de santé à la suite des dépôts de dossiers. • Dans le cadre du RGPD, veiller, en lien avec les DPO de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’AÉSIO Santé, à la conformité des projets et au respect des procédures. • Préparer et animer les réunions qualité / affaires réglementaires, contribuer aux comités de pilotage, suivre les indicateurs, élaborer des tableaux de bord et communiquer sur la démarche d’amélioration continue. • Participer aux réseaux professionnels et entretenir les relations utiles avec les autorités et organismes compétents (ANSM, ANS, CNIL, CPP, CNAM, etc.). • Définir les stratégies réglementaires des produits (classification, voie de mise sur le marché, marchés cibles : UE, France, puis international) • Assurer la veille sur les évolutions normatives et réglementaires (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746, AI Act, RGPD, cybersécurité, données de santé) et en mesurer l'impact • Anticiper les exigences liées aux innovations (logiciels dispositifs médicaux, IA, objets connectés, etc.) • Gérer les échanges avec les organismes notifiés • Sensibiliser et former les équipes internes aux enjeux réglementaires 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires, de la qualité ou du droit de la santé : • Licence professionnelle, Master 1 ou Master 2 en affaires réglementaires, droit de la santé, qualité appliquée aux produits de santé ou formation équivalente sont privilégié. Également une première expérience en affaires réglementaires dans le secteur de la santé (dispositifs médicaux, e-santé ou médicament). Profils juniors motivés à étudier selon le contexte.   Connaissances recherchées : • Réglementation des dispositifs médicaux et référentiels associés, notamment règlement (UE) 2017/745 (MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14155 et ISO 14971. • Réglementation des recherches cliniques, bonnes pratiques cliniques, RGPD, procédures de recherche clinique, cycle de développement d’un projet innovant en santé, vocabulaire médical et scientifique.   Compétences attendues : • Capacité à identifier et interpréter les exigences réglementaires et normatives applicables à un projet, et à les traduire en actions opérationnelles. • Maîtrise des méthodes d’analyse des risques, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion documentaire ; capacité à contribuer à des dossiers techniques et de marquage CE. • Capacité à conduire des projets transversaux, à argumenter des solutions en assurance qualité / affaires réglementaires et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs académiques, cliniques, industriels et institutionnels. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et capacité à élaborer des outils de suivi, indicateurs et tableaux de bord. • Anglais scientifique écrit ; capacité à échanger en anglais dans un contexte professionnel appréciée. Qualités personnelles : • Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, sens des priorités, polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation ; respect du secret professionnel, de l’éthique et de la réglementation en vigueur. • Curiosité pour l'innovation et capacité à trouver des solutions conformes • Aisance relationnelle, sens du travail en équipe et capacité à communiquer avec des partenaires variés. Des déplacements ponctuels en France sont à prévoir selon les projets. raw.title: Chargée ou chargé d'affaires réglementaires - CDD 12 Mois
raw.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

Au sein du Centre Ingénierie et Santé et du MedTechLab, vous contribuez au déploiement d’une stratégie technico-réglementaire permettant de sécuriser le développement, l’expérimentation, l’évaluation et, le cas échéant, la mise sur le marché de produits et services innovants en santé, notamment de dispositifs médicaux et de solutions de santé numérique.

Le MedTechLab®, cofondé par Mines Saint-Étienne, AÉSIO Santé et AÉSIO Mutuelle, est un espace d’open innovation dédié à la co-création, la modélisation, le test et l’expérimentation d’innovations pour la santé et l’autonomie. Lauréat de l’appel à projets Tiers Lieux d’Expérimentation de France 2030, il accompagne industriels, start-up et acteurs sanitaires et médico-sociaux dans des études d’usage, études cliniques, analyses médico-économiques, études de marché et démarches allant jusqu’au développement de produits minimum viables.

Vous intervenez en appui des équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, en lien avec les partenaires académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Vous accompagnez les projets sur leurs différentes étapes : R&D, stratégie réglementaire, recherche clinique, gestion des risques, constitution et maintenance de la documentation technique, marquage CE et suivi post-marquage.

Objectif du poste : garantir la prise en compte des exigences réglementaires et qualité applicables aux projets du MedTechLab et développer une culture partagée des affaires réglementaires au sein de l’écosystème.

Vos missions principales :

• Contrôler la conformité des activités et des processus au regard des référentiels applicables et contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de la documentation des systèmes et outils qualité.

• Dans le cadre du projet PREMYOM, accompagner le comité d’éthique interne du consortium en lien avec les DPO des différents partenaires.

• Identifier les normes et réglementations applicables aux projets de recherche et d’innovation du MedTechLab, assurer une veille réglementaire et normative et coordonner cette veille avec les partenaires.

• Accompagner la mise en œuvre des normes ISO 14155, ISO 13485 et ISO 14971, notamment pour les études cliniques, les systèmes de management de la qualité et l’analyse des risques.

• Accompagner les équipes dans la conformité des recherches cliniques et apporter un appui méthodologique et technique.

• Contribuer aux stratégies de marquage CE : supervision et rédaction des dossiers techniques, déclarations de mise sur le marché, maintien de la documentation de conformité et suivi post-marquage.

• Piloter l’évaluation réglementaire des changements, gérer la liste des normes appliquées aux projets et traiter les questions réglementaires et techniques des autorités de santé à la suite des dépôts de dossiers.

• Dans le cadre du RGPD, veiller, en lien avec les DPO de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’AÉSIO Santé, à la conformité des projets et au respect des procédures.

• Préparer et animer les réunions qualité / affaires réglementaires, contribuer aux comités de pilotage, suivre les indicateurs, élaborer des tableaux de bord et communiquer sur la démarche d’amélioration continue.

• Participer aux réseaux professionnels et entretenir les relations utiles avec les autorités et organismes compétents (ANSM, ANS, CNIL, CPP, CNAM, etc.).

• Définir les stratégies réglementaires des produits (classification, voie de mise sur le marché, marchés cibles : UE, France, puis international)

• Assurer la veille sur les évolutions normatives et réglementaires (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746, AI Act, RGPD, cybersécurité, données de santé) et en mesurer l'impact

• Anticiper les exigences liées aux innovations (logiciels dispositifs médicaux, IA, objets connectés, etc.)

• Gérer les échanges avec les organismes notifiés

• Sensibiliser et former les équipes internes aux enjeux réglementaires


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires, de la qualité ou du droit de la santé :

• Licence professionnelle, Master 1 ou Master 2 en affaires réglementaires, droit de la santé, qualité appliquée aux produits de santé ou formation équivalente sont privilégié. Également une première expérience en affaires réglementaires dans le secteur de la santé (dispositifs médicaux, e-santé ou médicament). Profils juniors motivés à étudier selon le contexte.

 

Connaissances recherchées :

• Réglementation des dispositifs médicaux et référentiels associés, notamment règlement (UE) 2017/745 (MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14155 et ISO 14971.

• Réglementation des recherches cliniques, bonnes pratiques cliniques, RGPD, procédures de recherche clinique, cycle de développement d’un projet innovant en santé, vocabulaire médical et scientifique.

 

Compétences attendues :

• Capacité à identifier et interpréter les exigences réglementaires et normatives applicables à un projet, et à les traduire en actions opérationnelles.

• Maîtrise des méthodes d’analyse des risques, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion documentaire ; capacité à contribuer à des dossiers techniques et de marquage CE.

• Capacité à conduire des projets transversaux, à argumenter des solutions en assurance qualité / affaires réglementaires et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs académiques, cliniques, industriels et institutionnels.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et capacité à élaborer des outils de suivi, indicateurs et tableaux de bord.

• Anglais scientifique écrit ; capacité à échanger en anglais dans un contexte professionnel appréciée.

Qualités personnelles :

• Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, sens des priorités, polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation ; respect du secret professionnel, de l’éthique et de la réglementation en vigueur.

• Curiosité pour l'innovation et capacité à trouver des solutions conformes

• Aisance relationnelle, sens du travail en équipe et capacité à communiquer avec des partenaires variés. Des déplacements ponctuels en France sont à prévoir selon les projets.

Relations professionnelles : médecins investigateurs, TEC, chefs de projets de recherche clinique, biostatisticiens, data-managers, équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, partenaires AÉSIO, structures de recherche clinique et technologique, start-up et industriels, ainsi que les instances administratives et réglementaires compétentes.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

  • Maîtrise impérative du Pack Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Capacités et aptitudes
