Job title: Head of Accounting

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Direct Reports: 2 Accounting Team Members

Scope: Global Accounting Oversight for PUR Group Entities

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Local, Permanent, Full time

About PUR

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

Position Summary

The Heah of Accounting is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of PUR's accounting records and financial reporting across the Group. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, coordinates monthly and annual closings, manages statutory and tax compliance, and serves as the primary accounting counterpart for Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes for Group entities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounting transactions in accordance with local GAAP and Group accounting policies.

  • Review and validate general ledger entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Monitor accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of accounting practices across entities.

Group Coordination

  • Act as the primary accounting liaison with Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in: Latin America, Africa and Asia

  • Coordinate closing calendars, reporting packages, and accounting guidelines.

  • Support regional teams in resolving complex accounting matters and ensuring compliance with Group policies.

  • Review key accounting judgments and significant transactions across regions.

Statutory Accounts & Compliance

  • Coordinate preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, accountants, and regulatory authorities.

  • Support the preparation of audit files and responses to audit requests.

  • Monitor evolving accounting and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate implementation.

Consolidation & Group Reporting

  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial information for management and shareholders.

  • Ensure timely submission of reporting packages from regional entities.

  • Review intercompany balances and transactions and coordinate reconciliation processes.

  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Group reporting standards.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Maintain robust accounting controls and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting activities.

  • Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to ERP and finance system optimization initiatives.

Treasury & Cash Management Support

  • Monitor cash accounting and treasury-related transactions.

  • Ensure proper accounting treatment of financing arrangements, loans, and intercompany funding.

  • Support working capital management through accurate balance sheet monitoring.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop two accounting team members.

  • Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload to ensure efficiency and quality.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Support training and professional development initiatives.


We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • DEC, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is a plus.

  • 8+ years of accounting experience in an international environment.

  • Experience leading accounting teams and managing audits.

  • Multi-country accounting exposure preferred.

  • Audit firm experience is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of French GAAP and international accounting standards.

  • Consolidation, intercompany accounting, and multi-currency environments.

  • ERP experience (NetSuite is a plus).

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

Key Success Factors

During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly closings across all entities.

  • Improve balance sheet reconciliation quality and documentation.

  • Strengthen collaboration with regional finance teams.

  • Enhance accounting controls and audit readiness.

  • Contribute to the standardization and automation of accounting processes.

  • Support the continued scalability of PUR's global finance function.

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment.  If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

title: Spécialiste Assurance Qualité Projets
description: Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement . Intégré au pôle Assurance Qualité Qualification, Validation & Projets, vous serez le représentant de l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets . Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité. Vos missions : Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements. Définir et rédiger la documentation Qualité associée aux projets, notamment les besoins utilisateurs, cahiers des charges, plans directeurs de validation et rapports associés. Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire . Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place. Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP , selon les besoins des projets. Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie. Revoir et contribuer à la rédaction des procédures, modes opératoires et autres documents Qualité nécessaires à la mise en exploitation. Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes. Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets. Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations. Requirements Chez Excelya, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels rigoureux, autonomes et capables de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires. Expérience : Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Assurance Qualité et Qualification/Validation dans l'industrie pharmaceutique . Expertise procédés : Vous possédez idéalement une expérience dans les procédés de formes sèches , notamment en extrusion, granulation sur LAF, compression et/ou conditionnement . Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés. Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP . Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA , de l' Annexe 15 des EU GMP , du 21 CFR Part 11 , des principes GAMP 5 , ICH Q9 et ALCOA+ . Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet. Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum , permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences. En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate ! raw.title: Data Scientist - Intern
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Data Science Intern - January 2027

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Science team, a group of around 70 data professionals working at the heart of Mirakl's platform. Together, you'll be making the most of rich and diverse marketplace data to grow customer revenue, optimize operations, and ensure the safety of users and transactions.

2. Your Impact

  • Analyze and prepare data to ensure quality and relevance for algorithm development, following best practices for exploration and transformation
  • Prototype and iterate on algorithms, testing and refining ideas with the support of your mentor and team
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to bring your solutions from experimentation to real-world production deployment
  • Build dashboards to showcase the relevance of your work and monitor performance in production
  • Present your findings weekly with the team, contributing to brainstorming sessions and tech watch initiatives

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in the final year of a Master's (Bac+5) in Computer Science at an engineering school or university
  • Familiarity with data preparation techniques and feature engineering
  • Understanding of statistics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms
  • Interest in the industrialization and scaling of data science models beyond experimental work

Skills:

  • Cloud environment awareness (AWS, Google Cloud, or MS Azure)
  • Strong communication and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Curiosity, autonomy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

4. Tech Stack

Python & its data science ecosystem (pandas,sklearn), SQL for data querying and manipulation, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Databricks, Spark, AWS (Amazon Redshift, S3), Airflow, Delta Lake, streamlit, pydantic 

5. Languages

  • French – Fluent required
  • English – Professional level required

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

Internship stipend: Based on your Master's status

Perks & Benefits:

  • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
  • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
  • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
  • 2 remote work days per month
  • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
  • Gymlib pass for your well-being
  • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
  • Swile meal vouchers
  • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with your future manager — Pierre Lourdelet, Data Scientist
  3. Interview with a future colleague, using structured STAR-method interviews to ensure transparency and fairness. 
  4. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

 

This is an internship position based in Paris, with up to two days of remote work permitted per month.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>-&nbsp;Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong></li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators.&nbsp;</strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career.&nbsp;</strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>When are you joining?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fall Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: September, October<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Spring Edition 2027<br></strong>Start dates: February, March<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <p>📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DE<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;">There is no </span><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">deadline</span>:</strong> Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>🚲Health and Transportation</strong><br>Through our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.</p> <p><strong>🍉Food</strong><br>Since we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.</p> <p><strong>📈Personal and Professional Development</strong><br>You will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.</p> <p><strong>🏖️All the rest</strong><br>You get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.<br>🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover.&nbsp;</p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.<br><br><br></p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yEQXLpeYN84?si=It-z9-XNLVMDeHEy" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., &amp; Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., &amp; Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., &amp; Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., &amp; Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. <em>CoRR abs/2308.02935</em>.</li> <li>Thong, W., Joniak, P., &amp; Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.</li> <li>Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., &amp; Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In <em>ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings</em> (pp. 5344-5351).</li> <li>Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., &amp; El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In <em>International conference on machine learning</em>(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.</li> <li>Giuliani, L., Misino, E., &amp; Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In <em>International Conference on Machine Learning</em> (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.</li> </ol> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Materials)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Open Roles</strong></span></p> <ol> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Linen, Cotton &amp; Other&nbsp;</li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Cashmere &amp; Silk&nbsp;</li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Denim, Active &amp; PKG Labels&nbsp;</li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Leather &amp; Down</li> </ol> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence &amp; efficiency, harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where T2 and T3 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent, and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Success in this role means achieving material cost at or near should-costing, below market indices, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Commodity Insights:</strong> Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends. Deliver actionable intelligence to procurement and leadership on a regular cadence. <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">Build and operationalize a live tracking system for key raw material prices, currency movements, and supply risks to proactively surface threats and opportunities.</li> </ul> </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Upstream Cost Engineering:</strong> Construct and scale material-specific clean sheets to lock in baseline component costs before finished-goods production. About the role

As Sales Manager for the French Market at Amenitiz, your primary objective is to ensure the day-to-day execution, coaching, and operational stability of a small, focused French sales team based in our new Lyon hub. You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development.

You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results.

We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners.

This is a newly created role opening our first commercial hub in France. You won't start from a blank page: you'll inherit an existing customer base, pipeline, tools, sales methodology, and the full support of the wider commercial team in Barcelona.

Your mission

  • Build and grow the Lyon team: recruit, train, and manage a team of SDRs, BDRs, and AEs

  • Run daily execution: manage pipeline health, call activity, and meeting volume across the team

  • Coach in the detail: listen to calls, give real-time feedback, and identify patterns that slow conversion

  • Hire and onboard: bring in the right profiles and get them productive quickly

  • Hold performance: track individual KPIs at every level, have honest conversations early, and support people to improve

  • Act as the link between the team and leadership: surface what is working, flag what is not, and translate direction into daily habits

  • Drive pipeline generation through a mixed approach (roughly 80% outbound, 20% inbound), with a short sales cycle (typically 1-2 weeks, up to one month)

  • Build a repeatable sales playbook to accelerate and scale the French market

  • Maintain HubSpot hygiene: ensure the team logs accurately so pipeline data can be trusted

  • Collaborate with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, and align outreach quality with closing requirements between SDRs, BDRs, and AEs

About you

  • 3+ years of experience managing a sales team, ideally in a SaaS, tech, or B2B environment (independent businesses/SMEs)

  • Native French speaker with strong written and verbal English (B1/B2 minimum)

  • Confirmed skills in outbound prospecting (cold calling) and short sales-cycle selling

  • Comfortable with HubSpot and Aircall (or similar tools)

  • You are a coach first: you get energy from developing people, not from being the best seller in the room

  • Strong organisational skills - you can manage a small team across multiple roles without losing track of the detail

  • Comfortable in a performance-oriented environment where targets are clear and accountability is real

  • Entrepreneurial, resilient, and autonomous, with genuine appetite for building a team "from scratch"

  • Experience in hospitality tech, online travel, or B2B SaaS is an advantage

Our offer

  • Competitive OTE - base salary plus performance-based commission

  • Stock options with a progressive vesting schedule

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • 25 days of holidays from day one, rising to 28 after your first year and 30 after two years

  • €10 a day for lunch through our virtual canteen, Kombo, every day you work from the office

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.

  • Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process.

  • Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools.

  • Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting and workback schedules, ensuring effective project management throughout the implementation.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support.   • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

title: Field Marketing Manager, SMB and Mid-Market - EMEA
description: <h2><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Stripe EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group dedicated to transforming customers into enthusiastic advocates for Stripe. Collaborating closely with sales, we focus on accelerating the path to purchase and enhancing product adoption among our user base. Our regional marketing efforts involve crafting and executing tailored marketing plans that resonate with local audiences, as well as spearheading our most significant conferences and sponsorships that drive go-to-market success and business growth. Join us and be part of a culture that celebrates teamwork, innovates boldly, and makes a meaningful impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a strategic, results-oriented marketing leader to drive our marketing engine for SMB and Mid-Market segments across EMEA, with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles. This segment represents a massive portion of Europe’s economic fabric and is a critical driver of our ambitions in the region.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence. You'll translate global priorities into locally resonant programs, ensuring that audiences in the SMB and Mid-Market space have high-quality, insight-driven experiences throughout their lifecycle, from early exploration to long-term partnership.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is data-driven, has an unbridled passion for working hand-in-hand with regional sales teams to drive successful user outcomes, and is excited about building a high-velocity revenue engine.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and execute the EMEA marketing strategy for SMB and Mid-Market segments with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles</li> <li>Own key business and revenue metrics throughout the sales funnel, with a strong emphasis on accelerating pipeline through upsell and cross-sell opportunities</li> <li>Collaborate with Partner Marketing to create successful co-selling initiatives that extend our reach within the partner and developer ecosystems</li> <li>Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel marketing plans, partnering with digital marketing and demand generation teams to secure high-value deals</li> <li>Partner closely with Sales leadership to align account plans, ensure disciplined lead follow-up, and establish trust as a strategic partner</li> <li>Collaborate with EMEA demand generation and product marketing to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content and marketing assets</li> <li>Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimizing for efficiency and scale while seeking to generate new global best practices, and innovate ways to educate a diverse range of personas about the value that Stripe delivers to businesses</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience in the EMEA technology market, including specific experience with demand generation and field marketing</li> <li>Proven track record of defining and executing B2B marketing strategies that successfully drive metrics, key performance indicators, and pipeline generation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex topics with simplicity to diverse audiences</li> <li>Strategic mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making, along with a deep understanding of full-funnel journeys and marketing technology like Salesforce</li> <li>Experience scaling programs through agency resources and collaborating across key go-to-market stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment</li> <li>Experience in the payments, financial technology, or adjacent industries, or marketing FinTech solutions or to FinTech companies</li> <li>Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems</li> <li>Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <h1><strong>Staff Digital Product Designer – E-Commerce / Web Platform</strong></h1> <p><strong>Department:</strong> E-Commerce &amp; Customer Experience / Web Team</p> <p><strong>Level:</strong> Individual Contributor Lead (Staff Level)</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Lille / Paris&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>1. Context &amp; Project</strong></h2> <p>Decathlon's purpose is to bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all, guiding our overarching ambition to build a <strong>Local Human Bond</strong> and deliver accessible, unique sporting solutions globally. In this context, our goal is to build personalized, enriched experiences across all digital touchpoints and physical stores, leveraging Digital, Data, and AI to elevate the global customer journey.</p> <h3><strong>The E-Commerce Web Challenge</strong></h3> <p>As the digital front door for millions of sport practice enthusiasts around the globe, our web platform (decathlon.country) must seamlessly convert online curiosity into real-world sport experiences. Our challenge is to transform a massive, multi-category web store into an intuitive, frictionless digital portal.</p> <p>We need to guide every user—from a first-time visitor searching for sports goods to a returning member—through a smooth journey that connects online browsing directly with local store availability, click-and-collect, and circular services like rentals and repairs.</p> <p>By building a standardized, modular web experience, we equip country teams and international franchise partners with pre-validated, high-converting funnel journeys so they can scale local commerce effortlessly without rebuilding core web experiences from scratch.</p> <h3><strong>Scope &amp; Structure (4 Dedicated E-Com Squads)</strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>Acquisition:</strong> Turn global internet users into active visitors through high-converting landing experiences, SEO, campaign entry points, and personalized traffic onboarding.</li> <li><strong>Navigation:</strong> Help users find the exact product or advice they need within a vast catalog through intelligent search, taxonomy, filtering, and catalog hierarchy.</li> <li><strong>Decision:</strong> Give users every compelling reason to choose a product using rich product detail pages (PDP), media, sizing confidence, customer reviews, and circular/sustainability options.</li> <li><strong>Conversion:</strong> Deliver frictionless checkout, flexible payment methods, order self-tracking, store pickup options, and effortless returns.</li> </ol> <h2><strong>2. Your Mission</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Digital Product Designer</strong>, you operate as a principal individual contributor and strategic leader within the Decathlon E-Commerce team. Operating with high autonomy on complex, cross-squad web challenges, you shape our long-term&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>E-Commerce Web Experience Vision</strong>.</p> <p>You will work in close triad leadership with <strong>Staff Engineering</strong> and <strong>Staff Product Managers (GPMs)</strong>, while partnering hand-in-hand with a <strong>dedicated UX Researcher (UXR)</strong> as your main practice partner to ground every design decision in deep user insights and quantitative data.</p> <p>Beyond defining strategy, you lead <strong>hands-on experimentation, product de-risking, and rapid validation loops</strong>—ensuring high-stakes web features across Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion are proven through A/B testing, CRO analysis, and real user data before global rollout. You align the 4 web squads around a unified web vision, accelerate commercial value delivery, and elevate design craft maturity across teams.</p> <h2><strong>3. What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Strategic Alignment &amp; Web Funnel Vision</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Triad Leadership:</strong> Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Staff PMs, and your dedicated UXR partner to define long-term roadmaps, tech feasibility, and strategic UX priorities across squads.</li> <li><strong>Web Experience Strategy:</strong> Define and advocate for the long-term web design strategy, establishing web principles that influence product and commercial roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>4-Squad Orchestration:</strong> Drive alignment across the <strong>Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion</strong> squads to ensure a cohesive end-to-end web journey without siloed user friction.</li> <li><strong>Priority Segment Focus:</strong> Set strategic web UX direction tailored to key user segments (<strong>Families, New Customers, Members</strong>), driving personalization and context-aware landing journeys.</li> <li><strong>Macro Metrics Tracking:</strong> Track and optimize web performance metrics across the full funnel: <strong>SEO Traffic, CTR, Search Success, Add-to-Cart Rate, Conversion Rate, and Retention</strong>.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Product De-Risking &amp; Web Experimentation Strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research Partner Alignment:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with UXR to formulate hypotheses, map user knowledge gaps, and design research strategies for complex e-commerce flows.</li> <li><strong>De-Risking Frameworks:</strong> Formulate and drive product de-risking strategies for high-impact web initiatives—identifying usability, commercial, and technical risks early in discovery.</li> <li><strong>Concrete Web Experimentation:</strong> Design and execute hands-on A/B tests, multivariate testing, CRO experiments, and prototype usability tests across the 4 squads to validate hypotheses before engineering rollouts.</li> <li><strong>Data-Informed Decisions:</strong> Partner with Data &amp; Analytics leads to build quantitative testing frameworks, leveraging web analytics to guide roadmap trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Testing Culture Elevation:</strong> Coach web product squads on hypothesis formulation, CRO best practices, and rapid build-measure-learn loops.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>4. Role &amp; Responsibilities (Skills &amp; Behaviors)</strong></h2> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>Craft / Technical Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research &amp; Web Strategy:</strong> Partner closely with our UXR to enrich foundational customer knowledge (B2C web journeys) and co-define a CX vision to build collective alignment across stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Problem Discovery:</strong> Uncover drop-off points across the 4 squads through quantitative funnel analytics and qualitative research; structure decisions using Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).</li> <li><strong>Solution Discovery:</strong> Explore and prototype web interfaces early and often; design high-converting, accessible, and responsive layouts connected to our Design System.</li> <li><strong>Testing &amp; CRO:</strong> Continuously de-risk solution feasibility, usability, and conversion lift using context-tailored testing tools (A/B testing, user testing, CRO analytics).</li> <li><strong>AI Exploration:</strong> Test and integrate AI tools (e.g., generative search, smart recommendations, automated layout testing) to amplify design and research workflows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Behaviors / Soft Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Strategic Collaboration:</strong> Lead cross-squad web taskforces alongside Staff Engineering and Staff PMs, make sound decisions under partial data, and support the Design Manager in org planning and hiring committees.</li> <li><strong>Influence &amp; Emotional Intelligence:</strong> Work proactively across PMs, Engineering Managers, and Business Leads to shape priorities using emotional intelligence and data-backed storytelling.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Involve engineering, data, UXR, and SEO teams early in the design process to create a psychologically safe, feedback-rich environment.</li> <li><strong>Design Mentoring:</strong> Elevate the web design practice by mentoring 3–4 designers, facilitating cross-squad design critiques, and connecting design solutions across teams.</li> <li><strong>Growth Mindset:</strong> Turn failed A/B experiments into collective learning opportunities and maintain a structured personal growth plan.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>5. Why Join the E-Commerce Web Team?</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Challenges You Will Tackle</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>High-Scale Web Impact:</strong> Optimizing a global web platform handling millions of daily visits across dozens of international markets.</li> <li><strong>4-Squad Synergy:</strong> Unifying <strong>Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion</strong> into one fluid, frictionless web journey.</li> <li><strong>Strong Triad Partnership:</strong> Working in direct alignment with Staff Engineering, Staff PMs, and a dedicated UXR partner to shape high-level product strategy.</li> <li><strong>Performance &amp; Accessibility at Scale:</strong> Designing lightweight, lightning-fast web pages that meet strict WCAG accessibility and SEO benchmarks.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>This Role Is a Perfect Match for You If…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You thrive on <strong>de-risking web journeys via A/B testing and CRO data</strong> rather than subjective opinions.</li> <li>You excel at <strong>triad collaboration</strong> with Staff Tech and Staff PMs, backed by deep research partnership with UXR.</li> <li>You enjoy <strong>orchestrating design across multiple squads</strong> (Acquisition through Conversion) to deliver a unified customer experience.</li> <li>You balance <strong>commercial conversion into&nbsp; goals with high design standards and accessibility</strong>.</li> <li>You love <strong>mentoring designers</strong> and upskilling teams in experimentation, data literacy, and web craft excellence.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.</p> <p><br><strong>Changing the game for good</strong>. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Jobexit
description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Sujet de stage Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

 


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold. 1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus. 2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves. Meet the team in our Zurich office. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
